text:
lina: quick idea 12/18 month private-offer templates with tiered discounts + optional hardware uplift. makes AE conversations predictable.

oliver: thumbs up. tiers could be: Bronze ($50k+), Silver ($200k+), Gold ($500k+). discount bands 5/8/12% respectively. HW uplift = one-time co-fund paid year 1 only.

tanya: need clear renewal gating. propose: same or higher commit to keep discount; otherwise drop one tier. also include a 60-day notice for intent to renew.

devon: can we do an early-adopter accelerator for partners who push marketplace SKUs to paid traffic within 30 days? small bonus credit (2-3%) if usage hits threshold. helps launch momentum. :rocket:

legal-bot: Flag: any co-fund or bonus must be framed as a "credit" applied to future marketplace spend and tied to an executed SOW. No language that implies cash back or third-party transfer. Add: "credits expire after 12 months and are non-transferable."

lina: noted. ops also needs SKU conventions. suggested mapping: `po_tier_bronze`, `po_tier_silver`, `po_tier_gold`, and `hw_uplift_v1`. ops can wire these into billing APIs.

oliver: example PO rule for automation: `if commit >= 200000 && signed_sow == true -> grant sku: po_tier_silver + hw_uplift_v1 (one-time)`

tanya: marketing question 1 when do we announce to the partner's marketplace listing? suggest: patch SKUs behind private offer flag; public announcement only after legal & partner consent + 14 days. prevents early leakage.

devon: For renewals, prefer a retention credit: if customer renews at >=90% of prior commit within 30 days, grant 50% of previous HW uplift as a credit. reduces churn while not full repeat funding.

legal-bot: Add minimum usage floor to prevent abuse. Recommend quarterly floor = 25% of committed ARR (rounded). Also require partner-provided usage attestation during audit window.

oliver: AE enablement: can we have a 1-page cheat sheet with threshold examples and timeline? I can draft and run it by SalesOps.

lina: yes please. draft due Wed EOD. I'll prep offer templates: `cofund-with-uplift` and `credits-only`.

devon: Ops note 1 ensure marketplace APIs accept an external SKU param so credits map cleanly. Otherwise partners will have to reconcile manually.

lina: action items: 1) Oliver to draft AE cheat sheet (due Wed). 2) Lina to create two PO templates and SKU list. 3) Legal-bot to provide exact contract language for credits and SOW clause. 4) Devon to validate marketplace API mapping. target sign-off next Fri.

lina: uploading draft templates to Notion in a bit: https://notion.redwood.com/partners/private-offers :point_up:
